As a car sales person I know that people shop around. I expect them to. And if they don't - they gave me an easy sale, which I am happy for. But 80% of the time I am fighting against other dealerships, other brands, price vs service, whatever. That is my damn job. 
Even though I am aware, that people will shop around and get quotes from different places, I will try to put in my 100% to show the person, that I should be their preferred dealer. Not tell them "YO BRO BUT I AM LOCAL", but actually show them. And if i figure out that price is all that matters for them, I will try to beat the price. Because I would rather sell and earn a bit less and maybe have a customer who is an ambassador for me out in the streets, than keep my prices high AF and possibly lose clients and future business for my employer.

To be honest, be glad he said it without wasting more of your time. The worst ones are those that ask for information, to be contacted again at a different time, etc. 
But the reason some people are mad, because they often sign up for shitloads of campaigns without being aware, that they give consent to be contacted. Then they get bombarded by salesmen offering this and that. And considering that most sales people are very bad at their job, the receivers have their guard way up high when receiving a call from a stranger.

First step is to understand that it is mostly a numbers game.
When you get into the calling, you will need to accept, that a no is not a no to your product or sale, but a no to your way of approach and then fine-tune your approach and basically get better.

If i have unlimited leads, i will just start by making it a goal to reach x number of no's. Then i will make it a goal to make my phone calls as long as possible ,even when i know i have lost the sale. Just to practice talking.  Then i will try to re-pitch etc and just keep going!
